scripts.pregenerate: npm run build -w @exactjs/compiler && npm run build -w @exactjs/theme
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run generate && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:heap: npm run build -w @exactjs/core -w @exactjs/ssr && npm run generate && node --expose-gc ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.heap.config.ts
scripts.test:allocation: npm run build -w @exactjs/core -w @exactjs/ssr && npm run generate && node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.allocation.config.ts
